rules: Each row and column contains the same number of suns and moons.
Three identical symbols cannot be consecutive, horizontally or vertically.
No two completed rows are identical. No two completed columns are identical.
Printed symbols are fixed. The symbols are also labelled, so colour is never the only clue.

hints.text: A1 must be a sun with your current entries: row 1 already has its full share of moons.

hints.applies: general tactic, not a claim of a forced move
hints.text: Then count each line’s symbols. When a line has half its cells of one kind, its other empty cells must be the other kind. Compare completed lines last.

answer: Every line is balanced, has no three equal neighbours and differs from every other line.
